recognize_zh: 周邊血中有數顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色並有細小空泡，核染色質細緻且核扭曲、摺疊或凹陷（promonocyte 樣），這些不成熟單核球樣細胞增加提示急性單核球性白血病。
features: Increased large mononuclear cells, about 2 to 2.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to low N:C ratio with folded, indented or convoluted nuclei
Fine, delicate chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and scattered fine azurophilic granules
Background shows a small lymphocyte, a band neutrophil, a platelet clump and normocytic red cells without schistocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large mononuclear cells with abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing sparse fine granules. Their nuclei are folded, indented or convoluted with fine, delicate chromatin, features of promonocytes and immature monocytes. A small lymphocyte and a band neutrophil are present; red cells are unremarkable and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are suggestive of acute monocytic leukemia; correlation with blast/promonocyte count, nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD36) is required.

ddx.vs: CMML contains mostly mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and lobulated nuclei, and promonocytes plus blasts are less than 20%.
Reactive monocytes have more condensed chromatin, lack a population of promonocytes/monoblasts, and resolve with the underlying infection or inflammation.
AMML additionally has at least 20% neutrophil-lineage cells in the marrow with myeloblasts that may contain Auer rods, rather than an exclusively monocytic population.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monocytic cells are MPO weak and NSE positive.
